title: Koch Curve Fractal
description: Interactive demonstration of the Koch snowflake fractal using recursive subdivision with adjustable recursion depth to explore self-similarity and fractal geometry.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Fractal Geometry
Recursion
Mathematics
Self-Similarity
Koch Snowflake
Computer Science
Chaos Theory
learningObjectives: Describe the Koch subdivision rule: split a segment into thirds and replace the middle third with two sides of an equilateral triangle
Calculate the segment count 4^n and total length (4/3)^n at recursion level n using the depth slider from 0 to 6
Explain why the Koch curve approaches infinite length while remaining inside a bounded region
Predict the visual change when the recursion depth slider advances from level 2 to level 4
Identify self-similarity by comparing a magnified bump with the whole curve at the same depth
